name: Scrovegni Chapel
scope: The standing medieval Scrovegni Chapel exterior, polygonal apse, brick belfry and attached north sacristy in the Arena grounds.
era: Present-day standing shell, including its historic later belfry.

originalReview.notes: The actual Firenze 1904 title leaf and Andrea Moschetti’s print on page 11 establish the exact published illustration. At right are the chapel’s west façade and south wall before removal of the former entrance portico. The old portico and palace serve only as historical context for the standing exterior.

review.method: Exactly matched public-domain originals, native building footprint and published architectural dimensions.
review.notes: Published Qualla media was checked first. Its eligible Giotto works show the interior frescoes, and the modern exterior is licensed CC BY-SA. The verified exterior reference is the unmodified, public-domain 1904 Fratelli Alinari print leaf. Textual material supports the standing state after the earlier porch was removed.
